## CapitalCallDraftFactory

Qualified name: <code>Meridian.Ledger.CapitalCallDraftFactory</code>. Kind: `class`.

Source: [src/Meridian.Ledger/CapitalCallDraftFactory.cs:12](../../../../src/Meridian.Ledger/CapitalCallDraftFactory.cs#L12).

Builds governed AutomatedJournalDrafts for commitment-driven capital-call postings so they satisfy every critical gate the private-capital fund-event projector enforces (effective date, idempotency key, fund event identity, capital-account impact via an equity leg, and evidence). Drafts flow through the standard AutomatedJournalApproval submit → approve → post lifecycle.

## CapitalCallScheduleDraftBuilder

Qualified name: <code>Meridian.Ledger.CapitalCallScheduleDraftBuilder</code>. Kind: `class`.

Source: [src/Meridian.Ledger/CapitalCallScheduleDraftBuilder.cs:14](../../../../src/Meridian.Ledger/CapitalCallScheduleDraftBuilder.cs#L14).

Composes a planned fund-level capital call into the set of governed capital-call issuance drafts: one balanced AutomatedJournalDraft per investor plan line, built through CapitalCallDraftFactory so every draft carries a deterministic idempotency key and flows through the standard AutomatedJournalApproval submit → approve → post lifecycle. This closes the wiring gap between CapitalCallPlanBuilder — which apportions a fund-level call across the commitment register — and the governed journal, which previously had no caller turning the plan into postings.

```csharp
public static class CapitalCallScheduleDraftBuilder
```

| Declaration | Source | Summary |

| <code>public static IReadOnlyList&lt;AutomatedJournalDraft&gt; BuildIssuanceDrafts(CapitalCallPlanRequest request, DateTimeOffset occurredAtUtc, IReadOnlyDictionary&lt;string, IReadOnlyList&lt;JournalEvidenceReference&gt;&gt;? evidenceByCommitmentId = null);</code> | [src/Meridian.Ledger/CapitalCallScheduleDraftBuilder.cs:20](../../../../src/Meridian.Ledger/CapitalCallScheduleDraftBuilder.cs#L20) | Builds and returns the governed issuance drafts for a fund-level call, planning it over the supplied commitment roll-forwards first. Fails closed when the plan is not executable. |
| <code>public static IReadOnlyList&lt;AutomatedJournalDraft&gt; BuildIssuanceDrafts(CapitalCallPlan plan, DateTimeOffset occurredAtUtc, IReadOnlyDictionary&lt;string, IReadOnlyList&lt;JournalEvidenceReference&gt;&gt;? evidenceByCommitmentId = null);</code> | [src/Meridian.Ledger/CapitalCallScheduleDraftBuilder.cs:41](../../../../src/Meridian.Ledger/CapitalCallScheduleDraftBuilder.cs#L41) | Builds the governed issuance drafts for an already-planned capital call. Each executable plan line becomes one balanced Dr capital-call receivable / Cr investor capital draft, in a deterministic per-investor order. Throws when the plan is not executable (allocated amount does not tie to the requested amount, no lines survive, or a critical validation issue is present) so a broken commitment state can never silently issue notices or postings. |
